auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. The verification button has been disabled.

settings.manageSessionWallet: Manage operator session state, register or sign in, and check wallet readiness from the live backend.
settings.controlActiveSession: Control your active session and understand token refresh behaviour.
settings.endsCurrentSession: Ends your current session and clears stored tokens from this browser. You will be redirected to the sign-in page.
settings.invalidateAllTokens: Invalidates all active refresh tokens for your account across every device. Use this if you suspect unauthorised access.
settings.sessionRefreshExplanation: Your access token is short-lived. When it expires the app automatically exchanges your refresh token for a new pair — you stay signed in without any action required.
settings.sessionExpiredMessage: If the refresh fails (token revoked, network error, or server restart) you will see a "Session expired" message and be redirected to sign in again. No data is lost; simply sign back in to continue.
settings.registerSignInValidate: Register, sign in, and validate the active backend session.
settings.loadCreateAccount: Load or create an operator account
settings.createLinkWallet: Create or link a wallet to continue
settings.loadWalletDetails: Load wallet details to inspect readiness
settings.walletBackendBridge: Create, link, and inspect the operator wallet through the backend bridge.
settings.horizonUnreachableTooltip: Horizon is unreachable — wallet actions disabled
settings.walletNotReadyIntro: Your wallet must be funded and have a trustline set up before payments can be processed.
settings.activateWalletStepBody: The wallet is currently inactive. Contact your administrator or re-link the wallet via the Wallet Status panel above.
settings.fundWalletStepBodySuffix: on the Stellar network to activate the account.
settings.trustlineStepBody: Your wallet is funded but missing a trustline for the payment asset. Use the Stellar Laboratory or your wallet app to add a trustline for the required asset.
settings.walletFullyReady: Wallet is fully ready — funded, trustline active, and usable for payments.
settings.horizonHealthCheck: Horizon endpoint health check for the {network} network
settings.horizonUnreachableBody: Stellar network actions (wallet creation, payments) are currently unavailable. Please check your network connection or the Horizon endpoint configuration.
settings.slaContractIdSubtitle: Resolved smart contract identifier used for SLA calculation calls
settings.contractNotConfiguredBody: No SLA contract is configured for this deployment. Set the NEXT_PUBLIC_SLA_CONTRACT_ID environment variable to display the real contract address on this card.
settings.contractMismatchBody: The configured SLA contract ID does not match the canonical published contract ID for the {network} network. Double-check your NEXT_PUBLIC_SLA_CONTRACT_ID environment variable to ensure it points to the correct contract.

errors.signOutFailed: Sign out failed. Please try again.

dashboardKpis.body: Compliance, penalties, rewards, and net balance update live from the backend. This is your starting point every shift.

dashboardFilters.title: Slice the metrics
dashboardFilters.body: Narrow every chart and KPI by date range, severity, or site to focus on what matters right now.

paymentsFilters.title: Filter payouts

paymentsTable.title: Payment history
paymentsTable.body: Every automated blockchain payout lands here. Click any row to inspect its full detail. That is the tour — you are ready to go!
